reports.cat.management-summary.descripti: Ibipimo by'ingenzi ugereranyije n'igihe cyabanje, umusaruro ku ruganda, ibyagurishijwe, amafaranga, igiciro cy'abakozi, ibitegereje kwemezwa n'ibikoresho bike.
reports.cat.management-summary.title: Incamake y'ubuyobozi
reports.cat.materials-daily.description: Igitabo cy'ibikoresho fatizo ku ruganda rumwe: ibyari bihari, ibyakiriwe, ibyimuwe, ibyakoreshejwe n'ibisigaye.
reports.cat.materials-daily.title: Raporo ya buri munsi y'ibikoresho fatizo
reports.cat.materials-position.descripti: Ibisigaye by'ibikoresho ku ruganda kuri itariki runaka, ibiri munsi y'urugero rwo gutumiza bikagaragazwa.
reports.cat.materials-position.title: Uko ibikoresho fatizo bihagaze
reports.cat.payroll-summary.description: Amabaruwa y'imishahara y'abakozi b'igihe gito arangirira muri iki gihe, ku ruganda no ku cyiciro cyo kwemezwa.
reports.cat.payroll-summary.title: Incamake y'imishahara
reports.cat.pettycash-statement.descript: Amafaranga yari ahari, ayashyizwemo, ayakoreshejwe yemejwe hamwe n'ikiguzi cya MoMo, n'asigaye ku musozo w'igihe.
reports.cat.pettycash-statement.title: Raporo y'amafaranga make
reports.cat.production-summary.descripti: Umusaruro w'akazi wemejwe ku ruganda no ku bwoko bw'igicuruzwa: intego, ibyakozwe, ibyangiritse, ingero, blokoyi nziza n'igihe imashini yahagaze.
reports.cat.production-summary.title: Incamake y'umusaruro
reports.cat.sales-receivables.descriptio: Amadeni abakiriya basigaye bafite uyu munsi, hamwe n'igihe ibyagurishijwe byemejwe bitarishyurwa bimaze.
reports.cat.sales-receivables.title: Raporo y'amadeni abakiriya bafite
reports.cat.sales-report.description: Ibyagurishijwe byemejwe muri iki gihe ku mukiriya no ku gicuruzwa, hamwe n'inomero za EBM n'ubwishyu bwakiriwe.
reports.cat.sales-report.title: Raporo y'ibyagurishijwe
reports.cat.stock-daily.description: Imigendekere y'ibicuruzwa byarangiye ku ruganda rumwe: ibyari bihari, ibyakozwe, ibyangiritse, ibyasohotse n'ibisigaye kuri buri gicuruzwa.
reports.cat.stock-daily.title: Raporo ya buri munsi y'ububiko bwa blokoyi
reports.cat.stock-position.description: Blokoyi ziri ku ruganda rwose kuri itariki runaka.
